description_en: Queries the hotline agent status in the Cloud Customer Service System by agent account name
description_zh: 根据坐席账号名称查询悉犀客服工作台热线坐席状态
name: GetHotlineAgentStatus

parameters.help_en: The AICCS instance ID. You can find this on the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The agent account name, which is unique within the instance (login name)
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
parameters.name: account_name
